query: A consumer electronics factory operates an assembly line with three workstations and can produce 101 premium radio models: HiFi-1, HiFi-2, …, HiFi-101. The processing time required per unit of each model at each workstation is provided in workstation_times.csv. Each workstation has 1,440 minutes of total daily time. Daily maintenance consumes 10% of the available time at workstation 1, 14% at workstation 2, and 12% at workstation 3, so production may use only the remaining effective capacity of each workstation. Determine the nonnegative integer number of units of each radio model to produce per day so as to minimize total idle production time across the three workstations. For each workstation, idle time is its effective daily capacity minus the total processing time used at that workstation.
generated_model:

#### Decision Variables

- $x_m \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}$: number of units of model $m$ to produce per day
- $I_w \geq 0$: idle time (in minutes) at workstation $w$

#### Objective

Minimize total idle time across all workstations:
$$
\min \sum_{w=1}^3 I_w
$$

#### Constraints

For each workstation $w$:
- Idle time is effective capacity minus total processing time used:
  $$
  I_w = C_w - \sum_{m=1}^{101} a_{w,m} x_m \qquad \forall w=1,2,3
  $$
- Idle time cannot be negative:
  $$
  I_w \geq 0 \qquad \forall w=1,2,3
  $$
- Total processing time used cannot exceed effective capacity:
  $$
  \sum_{m=1}^{101} a_{w,m} x_m \leq C_w \qquad \forall w=1,2,3
  $$
- Nonnegativity and integrality:
  $$
  x_m \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0} \qquad \forall m=1,\ldots,101
  $$

#### Complete Model

Minimize:
$$
I_1 + I_2 + I_3
$$

Subject to, for all $m=1,\ldots,101$ and $w=1,2,3$:
\[
\begin{align*}
I_1 &= 1296 - \sum_{m=1}^{101} a_{1,m} x_m \\
I_2 &= 1238.4 - \sum_{m=1}^{101} a_{2,m} x_m \\
I_3 &= 1267.2 - \sum_{m=1}^{101} a_{3,m} x_m \\
I_w &\geq 0 \\
x_m &\in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}
\end{align*}
\]

where $a_{w,m}$ are the processing times from the tables above, and $C_1=1296$, $C_2=1238.4$, $C_3=1267.2$.

All data and identifiers are preserved in source order.
